blind_spots_patched: The original dossier omitted that SEDEMAC's March 2026 IPO was a 100% Offer for Sale (zero fresh capital to the company) and did not analyze post-lock-up PE block-deal overhang or active ESOP 2025 dilution.

Aggregated Screener borrowings (Rs 352 Cr) and Fixed Assets (Rs 518 Cr) in Sep 2026 mask Ind AS 116 lease liabilities, Right-of-Use assets, short-term working-capital debt surge, and negative H1 FY27 operating cash flow.

The original Chapter 4 competitive matrix benchmarked only global Tier-1s (Bosch, Denso, Continental, Mahle) and genset peers (DSE, ComAp), overlooking scaled domestic low-voltage EV controller rivals including TVS-group affiliate Lucas-TVS and Sterling Tools.
assumptions_changed: WEAKENED: Industrial genset controllers provide a steady high-growth second leg (15–20%+ sustained growth after FY26's 55% surge to Rs 146 Cr on CPCB IV+ adoption).
CONFIRMED: Mobility sensorless ISG, ISG+EFI, and EV MCU volume velocity is scaling across domestic and export OEM platforms.
WEAKENED: Operating cash flow remained positive while growth capex drove negative Free Cash Flow, with Sep 2026 borrowings rising from Rs 72 Cr to Rs 352 Cr.
WEAKENED: Industrial genset segment sustains 15–20%+ growth trajectory as a key operational KPI in the Ch-5 scorecard.
